availability.note: GWM AU Cannon range page lists the Lux PHEV with a VIC private drive-away price; Build & Price link https://www.gwmanz.com/au/config/cannon/ (configurator is script-rendered, prices not readable); CarExpert/4x4 Australia confirm two grades, Lux and Ultra, both 4x4 dual-cab pickups; in dealers since 21 Oct 2026 (zecar)

listPrice.note: GWM publishes drive-away only: $50,990 drive-away, VIC private buyer, standard price before the $2,000 launch bonus (bonus runs to deliveries by 30 Nov 2026, so ignored as a campaign). Ute divisor: (50990 - 958.80) / 1.027 = 48,716; round-trip through calc/onroad.js driveAwayPrice (isNonPassenger true) = 50,990.41. No independent on-road estimate exists to verify against; the $1,000 ABN-vs-private gap and $4,000 Lux-Ultra gap are both GWM-chosen. CarExpert's spec page states '$48,990 before on-road costs', which is exactly the private campaign drive-away figure and is below what a $48,990 list would cost on the road in VIC, so it is a mislabelled drive-away price and was rejected. Same $50,990/$54,990 private and $49,990/$53,990 ABN figures in CarExpert, 4x4 Australia, zecar, CarSauce. Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 48,793 at $880; round trip 50990.13).

batteryKwh.note: 'Max battery kilowatt hour: 33.11 kWh' LFP (SVOLT per autotrader NZ); every source quotes 33.1kWh unlabelled, usable not published. Treated like the sibling Cannon Alpha's unlabelled 37.11kWh.

rangeKm.note: GWM AU '115km Pure Electric Range' (NEDC), GWM internal testing. No WLTP figure found: GWM sells this ute only in non-WLTP markets (AU, NZ, China). zecar mentions '~98kkm' WLTP with a typo and no source; not used. Testers: Chasing Cars matched 115km, CarSauce ~100km, autotrader NZ estimated 85-90km.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 33.11 / 115 x 100 = 28.79; no published EV-mode figure. Tautological against the cross-check.

combinedRangeKm.note: rangeKm + tank / fuelConsumptionL100km x 100 = 115 + 75 / 8.1 x 100 = 1041. Tank 75L per CarExpert spec page, Chasing Cars, 4x4 Australia, autotrader NZ. GWM's own figure is 1037km NEDC.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: No published charge-sustaining figure. Derived from GWM's own claimed 1037km NEDC combined range (gwmanz cannon-phev page) with 115km EV range and 75L tank: (1037 - 115) / 75 = 12.29 km/L = 8.13 L/100km. Same method reproduces the sibling Cannon Alpha's GWM 7.9 L/100km (heavier, 2810kg vs 2585kg kerb; Hi4-T here has 310kW vs 300kW). Real-world evidence is worse: CarSauce measured about 12.9 L/100km on the freeway with a depleted battery; ACM syndicated review suggests about 9 L/100km is realistic. Kept the GWM-derived figure for consistency with the Alpha, Tank 300 (8.3) and Tank 500 (8.4) rows, all GWM figures.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Combined label 'Combined: 2.4 L/100km' (NEDC), at or below 3.5. Also CarExpert news, Chasing Cars, autotrader NZ.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: Ute: field rules require false on every ute row; Victoria charges utes as goods vehicles (isNonPassengerForVicDuty true).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Tub litres unpublished. CarExpert spec page: cargo length 1520mm, width 1520mm, height 540mm; CarSauce measured 517.5mm depth with a raised battery section in the floor and 1140mm between the arches. 1520 x 1520 x 517.5 = 1196 L; reads 10-20% high because arches are ignored. Siblings: Cannon Alpha 1140, Shark 6 1200, Ranger PHEV 1185.

seats.note: Crew cab pickup, 4 doors, rear 'Seating capacity: 3' plus two front seats; dual cab per CarExpert news and autotrader NZ.

towKg.note: 'Braked Towing Capacity: 3,500 kg'; 350kg towball, 6400kg GCM per 4x4 Australia; GWM page '3500kg Braked Towing Capacity'.

warrantyYears.note: '84 month, unlimited km warranty'; battery 96 months. GWM page: '7-year unlimited kilometer warranty', no servicing condition stated (matches GWM reference value 7).

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to ford-ranger-phev-xl (1700 at $54,300) and byd-shark-6-dynamic-cab-chassis (1750 at $55,900); cheaper list price but 310kW and a new nameplate, so matched to the Ranger XL rather than lower. Alpha Lux sits at 1900 at $59,990.

depreciationCurve.note: GWM ute convention: same curve as gwm-cannon-alpha-phev. Evidence for below-mainstream retention: a $2,000 launch bonus extended within weeks of dealer arrival (zecar), brand-wide drive-away campaigns on the Alpha, unrated by ANCAP (CarSauce).
